thought.text: The change is confirmed. `_rest_of_line` now matches `\r\n` before `\n` and `\r`, consistent with `_newline` (line 18) and `_end_of_line` (line 29).

action.message:
Implemented the repair in src/dotenv/parser.py only.

Change: `_rest_of_line` alternation reordered from `(?:\r|\n|\r\n)?` to `(?:\r\n|\n|\r)?` (line 30), matching the ordering already used by `_newline` and `_end_of_line`.

Effect: On error recovery, a CRLF is now consumed as one complete newline. The invalid binding's `original.string` includes the whole CRLF, and the following valid binding starts at line 2 with `original.string` exactly `GOOD=ok\n`. LF and lone-CR inputs are unaffected (their alternatives still match), and repeated invalid lines each consume exactly one terminator, so recovery continues correctly.

No tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies were modified. The implementation is ready for the host to run tests.

tool_call.name: finish
